notes: Hand-authored, not derived. Rule: the file that decides the per-member entry list. src/config/nav.ts declares SIDEBAR_NAV — each entry naming the permission action and optional feature flag that gate it — and visibleNav(), which filters the tree by calling can() and consulting the flag snapshot; its own header states it is the only place that decision is made. EXCLUDED: src/components/domain/nav/app-sidebar.tsx and top-bar.tsx (render whatever visibleNav returns; the file-name-driven search lands here first); src/lib/permissions.ts and src/lib/feature-flags.ts (general predicates with no knowledge of menu entries); src/components/domain/flags/feature-gate.tsx (gates arbitrary subtrees, not the entry list).
